src/auth.rs.reason: Auth runtime remains broad because it coordinates sessions, OIDC, tokens, CSRF, sudo, passkeys and local login; split before extending auth flows.

src/config.rs.reason: Configuration loading, sidecar migration and runtime settings are still centralized; split before adding more config domains.

src/parsers.rs.reason: Notification parser parity is consolidated for migration safety; split by source only with golden parity coverage.

static/i18n.js.reason: Translation catalog is centralized for the current vanilla UI; split by locale or feature before adding large copy blocks.

static/index.html.reason: Single-page UI markup is still static HTML; split templates/components before adding new full-page surfaces.

static/style.css.reason: Single stylesheet owns the full admin UI theme; split into layout/view/theme layers before adding substantial UI styling.

tests/e2e/klaxond.spec.ts.reason: End-to-end coverage is consolidated around one server fixture; split by feature area before adding more UI scenarios.
